title: State verbs and prompt-context route through workflow records
action: Migrate resolveMutationTarget/resolvePipeline (state set/gate/scribing-run/advisor-ref) and bee-prompt-context reads onto workflow records: session→workflow binding (extend session record lane field semantics to workflow_id, keeping lane name as alias), explicit --lane still resolving to the feature's workflow. Missing/corrupt workflow refuses loudly. All existing CLI state tests stay green; new test: two sessions bound to two workflows mutate phases concurrently, no interference and no shared lock wait. Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors). Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed).

truths: concurrent phase mutations on two workflows: zero LOCK_BUSY (test)
unbound session still targets default projection unchanged
missing workflow refuses loudly, never silent fallback
prohibitions: no silent fallback from a named workflow to the default record

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: Closed the C5 residual seam: state set/gate/scribing-run/advisor-ref record now route a DEFAULT (non-lane) target through its own live workflow record, exactly like lanes since msn-7 — via a new writeStateRecordThroughProjection sibling of writeLaneRecordThroughProjection, an extended rebuildStateProjection idle-gate (feature-matched branch authoritative even non-idle), and a C4-safe withMutationLock that locks per-workflow (workflow:<id>) instead of the blanket 'state' lock, closing invariants 1/2 (zero cross-workflow LOCK_BUSY). A new updateWorkflowAssumingLock in workflow-store.mjs avoids a same-lock nested-acquire deadlock. Narrow carve-outs (a --feature swap on the default record, C1 no-workflow legacy repos) stay byte-identical to pre-cell behavior. Session->workflow binding stays via the existing 'lane' field alias (no schema break); resolvePipeline's read path is unchanged in code (already reflects the workflow record via the kept-in-sync projection file) with its doc comment updated to state this explicitly.
